data.name: Lanternsong
data.detailed_description:
Night has settled over a village that has gone quiet. Its lanterns stand cold, and its song has faded to silence. You are the Keeper — and one lantern at a time, you bring it back.

You don't light this village with fire. You light it with fireflies — small, singing lights that gather in the dark and carry a fragment of the melody each lantern holds. Coax them to follow your handheld lantern, lead them home, and watch a corner of the village wake in warm light and sound.

There are no timers. No failure. No arrows telling you where to go. Just a path through a sleeping village, a lantern in your hand, and a song that grows fuller with every light you wake.

Features

  • A cozy first-person night to wander at your own pace

  • Light lanterns using singing fireflies, not fire

  • A soundtrack that builds itself as you play — each lantern adds a layer

  • A hand-built village to explore: farms, a pond, a pasture, quiet corners with their own small stories

  • No pressure, no fail states — just light, music, and night

  • Built solo in Godot

Sound on. The music is the whole point.
